name: Kumaro Login Styler Lite
author: Prageeth Kumaraguru

sections.description:
Kumaro Login Styler Lite allows you to personalize the default WordPress login page in just a few clicks.

Whether you want to display your company logo, match your website branding, or create a more professional login experience, this lightweight plugin makes customization simple and secure.

Unlike many login customization plugins, Kumaro Login Styler Lite focuses on essential features with a clean interface, minimal settings, and excellent performance.

Features

  • Upload a custom login logo
  • Change login logo width
  • Set a custom background color
  • Upload a full-page background image
  • Customize the login button color
  • Adjust login form border radius
  • Change the logo destination URL
  • Customize the logo title attribute
  • One-click reset to default settings
  • Native WordPress Media Library integration
  • Lightweight and fast
  • No coding required
  • Translation ready
  • Built using WordPress Coding Standards

Credits

Developed and maintained by NextGen Scripts.

Website:
https://www.nextgenscripts.dev
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Kumaro Login Styler Lite.
  4. Configure your preferred login page settings.
  5. Click Save Changes.
  6. Visit your WordPress login page to see the changes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace the WordPress login page?

No. The plugin customizes the existing WordPress login page without replacing WordPress core files.

Can I upload my own company logo?

Yes. You can upload any logo using the built-in WordPress Media Library.

Can I use a custom background image?

Yes. Simply upload a background image and it will be displayed behind the login form.

Can I change the login button color?

Yes. You can easily choose any button color using the built-in color picker.

Can I customize the login form border radius?

Yes. You can control how rounded the login form corners appear.

Can I change where the login logo links?

Yes. By default, the WordPress logo links to WordPress.org. This plugin lets you change it to your own website.

Can I change the logo tooltip?

Yes. You can customize the logo title text shown when users hover over the logo.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads the necessary assets on the login page and plugin settings page.

Does this plugin modify WordPress core files?

No. It uses standard WordPress hooks and does not modify any core files.

Is coding knowledge required?

No. Everything can be configured through an easy-to-use settings page.

Will my settings remain after updating the plugin?

Yes. Plugin updates do not remove your saved settings.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin includes an uninstall routine that removes its stored settings for a clean uninstall.
